criteria.name: bias

criteria.name: coverage
criteria.detail: TE pooled coverage is 0.846, above the 0.83 cap. The other positions are inside the band.

criteria.name: lineup_points
criteria.detail: +1591.3 lineup points versus the legacy baseline across 72 weeks. This is not a Yahoo comparison.

notes: The M3 candidate was not promoted.
Mean-head bias is still outside ±0.3 in seven position-seasons.
Calibrated 10/90 coverage is inside 80% ± 3 points except at tight end.
q50 remains the primary accuracy metric. The mean head did not win three seasons.
These figures compare the model with the legacy baseline. They are not a claim against Yahoo. Yahoo capture is a later milestone.
